thesis: The episode introduces Orlando Bravo, founder and managing partner of Thoma Bravo, as a guest on the seventh episode of the Private Equity Masters miniseries. The conversation covers Bravo's background, early investment lessons, and approach regarding management, analytics, and collaborative culture.
